headline: Bitcoin Rose 1.59 Percent to 83k as Options Paid for Downside
narrative: Bitcoin rose 1.59 percent to 83k, with cumulative volume delta buy-side leaning at the 73rd percentile of its 30-day range. The options pipe priced protection into the October 14 expiry, skew at 26.11, puts at 76k against calls at 92k, downside heavily bid. Funding on bitcoin perpetuals was negative at -0.0015, a crowded-short pipe, while exchange reserves fell 1,712 bitcoin over seven days.
author: jordan
